parsed.label: Adjusted EBITDA

figures.quote: Excluding the impact of business combinations and other non-recurring and special items, Adjusted EBITDA was $289 million versus $383 million in the same quarter last year.
Excluding the impact of business combinations and other non-recurring and special items, Adjusted EBITDA was $289 million versus $383 million in the same quarter last year.

parsed.notes: The reconciliation table is not in the excerpt, so both figures come from the narrative text. No year-to-date Adjusted EBITDA is given. The full-year 2026 figure of about $1.05 billion is guidance, not a reported result, so it is left out. Third-quarter Adjusted EBITDA margin was 13.2% in 2026 and 17.5% in 2025. The figures in the release are labelled 'third quarter', and the period-end dates assume a calendar quarter ending September 30.
